business_overview.revenue_model: Products are sold directly to customers including distributors; control transfers on warehouse delivery. Normal credit term is 30-180 days for cement customers and 180-365 days for concrete customers.
business_notes: All revenue is recognised at a point in time.
No individual customer contributed over 10% of group sales in 2024 or 2023.
The group operates principally in the PRC; subsidiaries are mainly PRC cement/concrete manufacturers and logistics/service entities.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2022-2023 operating cash flow less capex was strong, but 2024 fell to roughly breakeven after capex while parent net profit turned negative. Three-year cash data supports cash generation in normal years, but cyclicality and the latest downturn require a heavy profit haircut rather than using the best year.

evidence.source: 2024 annual report statement of financial position and note 26(a), PDF p.69 and p.149

gaps: The annual report does not split group bank balances by listed parent, offshore subsidiaries and PRC operating subsidiaries beyond the company-only balance sheet; owner-earnback cash haircut therefore uses a mainland/group-cash discount.
The term profile beyond “original maturity over three months” is not disclosed; the main haircut assumes deposits are bank deposits but not immediately parent-level distributable cash.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed from growth capex; owner-earnback uses purchase of property, plant and equipment as a conservative capex proxy.

No exact normal working-capital reinvestment estimate is disclosed; operating cash flow already includes annual working-capital movements, so the profit denominator is additionally haircut rather than double-deducting an arbitrary amount.
